in_latin.name: Julia
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin name Julia is derived from Greek , meaning 'descended from Jupiter' or 'youthful'. In the early Christian church, the name Julia was associated with Saint Julia of Corsica and Saint Julia of Nicomedia, and was considered a symbol of modesty and humility. The name Julia has been used in various forms throughout history, including Juliana and Juliana.
